cohort: Women with a previous Cesarean Section at ≥ 37 weeks' gestation, 12-15 months prior to the study
finding: The stiffness of the uterine scar is higher than that of the surrounding myometrium in women with a prior cesarean section.
mod_finding: Cesarean scar stiffness, as measured by elastography, was not significantly different between women who had a previous vaginal delivery and those who did not.
